_note: Public corrections log, shown on /corrections/ (newest first). Hand-kept: add an entry whenever a published brief, story, listing or page is corrected. Fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD the fix went live), page (site path, e.g. /briefs/2026-11-06/), what (the item), wrong (what we said), right (what's correct now / what we did). An entry whose page is a brief or story also appears as a correction note at the end of that brief or story. Don't name private individuals; don't log typo fixes that don't change meaning. Entries before 2026-11-07 were reconstructed from the site's change history.
